constraints: variable may only refer to a process variable or a 4D method argument ($0 to $n); local and interprocess variables cannot be used.
This command does not support blob objects (4D.Blob type) as the declared variable's value.
In input_output, pass 1 (SOAP input) for a value received by the method, or 2 (SOAP output) for a value returned by the method.
If alias is omitted, 4D uses the variable's name (or FourD_argN for method arguments $0-$n) as the published name by default.
alias must be unique across all input and output parameters declared for the same RPC call; if it is not, only the last declaration with that alias is taken into account.
alias must not begin with a number or contain spaces, and extended/accented characters are discouraged.
This command must be called from within the method published as the Web Service itself; it cannot be called from another method.
Incoming SOAP arguments referred to via 4D variables (rather than method arguments) must first be declared in the COMPILER_WEB project method.
